title: Debugging and troubleshooting DI
description: Learn how to diagnose and resolve common dependency injection errors in Angular such as NG0200, NG0201, and circular dependencies.

blocks.text: Angular provides descriptive runtime error codes when dependency injection encounters issues. This guide covers common errors and how to resolve them.

This error occurs when service A depends on service B, and service B simultaneously depends on service A. Break circular dependencies by extracting shared logic into a separate third service or using forward references.
NG0201: No provider found for token

This error happens when a component or service requests a token that was never configured in an available injector. Verify that the service includes @Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' }) or is listed in the component/application providers array.
